    pub provider: SubscriptionProvider,
    pub account: String,
    pub canonical_id: String,
    pub raw: serde_json::Map<String, Value>,
    pub source_order: u64,
    pub fetched_at: i64,
    pub health_generation: String,
    pub protocols: BTreeSet<crate::client_policy::ClientProtocol>,
}
